chunks: What al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Ali, from Abi Ibrahim عليه السلام, who said:
I heard him saying: The pilgrim should not take provisions from his sacrificial animal, though he may eat from it during its days, except for the hump, for indeed it is a remedy.
Ahmad said: And he said: There is no harm in the pilgrim purchasing some of the meat of Mina and taking it as provisions.

key_terms.أُضْحِيَّتِهِ: his sacrificial animal offered in the rite

ai.seo_question: Can a pilgrim take meat from his sacrificial animal in Mina as provisions?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the meat of the sacrificial offering in Mina during hajj. It indicates that the pilgrim should not take provisions from his own uḍḥiyah, while he may eat from it during its designated days, and it permits buying meat from Mina and taking it as provisions.
